far_field_HI_rule: E1-M off-axis drillings (back face = FE far field): the Dirichlet far field is an unlimited source under a stiff boiling sink, so HI = LO x (FE head-bore E at G 10 W/K / E at G 1 W/K) = x 7.59

head_end_W_vs_t.note: t from MECO to RELIGHT of the duty cycle (s from ignition); Q into the trapped liquid (W); FE bore series sampled at the frd steps (~1 s) and interpolated; the needle tip estimate (50 LO / 150 HI J) is not in the series

note_fe_hi: HI uses the FE G 10 W/K run when given (--fe_hi), otherwise the G 1 W/K value (then HI understates the head-end bore)
